subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

**APPRISE**
solution:
The correct answer is "apprise"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Look at the meaning of the given word in the question:
 
 
• **Apprise**- inform or tell someone.
 
 
 
• Look at the meanings of the rest of the options:
 
 
• **Hide**- to escape, keep out of sight.
 
• **Notify**- inform someone of something.
 
• **inform**- to notify someone
 
• **Enlighten**- give great knowledge.
 
 
 
• We can clearly see that notify, inform and enlighten are the synonyms of Apprise
 
• Although hide is not the direct opposite of "apprise", it insinuates escaping.
 
• Hence, the correct answer will be ***"hide"***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
